language_policy.decision: All authored artifacts stored in the A2 profile are English. French is reserved for implementation conversations with Séverine.

scoring_policy.A1_ownership: A1 owns ICP criteria, evidence validation, the scoring model and deterministic score calculation.
scoring_policy.A2_role: A2 may create a requalification signal when verified enrichment materially affects an A1 criterion.
scoring_policy.revision_rule: A score may change only as a new A1-generated, human-approved revision. The original score, components, evidence and approval history remain immutable.
scoring_policy.A2_prohibited_action: A2 must not award points, calculate a replacement score or silently overwrite an A1 score.

next_gate: Canonical A2 Enrichment Record, including the requalification_signal and score-revision references
